name: Domino MR
summary:
Welcome to Domino MR! A free Mixed Reality (MR) sandbox that turns your room into a domino playground.

- YOUR ROOM IS THE STAGE: Scan your room and build domino chains on your real floor and tables using Mixed Reality.
- HAND TRACKING: Use your own hands to grab, place, and topple dominos.


**THIS IS AN EARLY ACCESS APP**

This app is in active development. We welcome your feedback to make it better!
